originalMetadata.identity: Tall cargo shell, large rear glass and low oval lamps. Marine-blue body, white arches/bumper and dark roof follow the user-supplied Yokohama Version poster.
originalMetadata.art: Original code-native pixel illustration; no traced source pixels, manufacturer logo, external image, or font.
originalMetadata.rendering: Draw one 96x96 frame at square aspect. The three state poses are not an autoplay animation. Ground anchor is shared with the player.
originalMetadata.driver: Enclosed car or cab; no separate exposed driver sprite.
originalMetadata.colorNote: Approximation of the first user-supplied printed Yokohama Version poster. Clean side-panel sample medians #4384D6 and #4684D4; shaded hood #2166C3. These are photo samples, not a verified factory paint-code conversion. Explicit blue-body exception applies only to S-Cargo.
originalMetadata.liveryDetails: White left/right REAR-edge strips stay visible in every pose on the rear plane (z=0). Exposed side panels remain marine blue. White rear bumper and wheel-arch trims; dark canvas roof. Second poster supplies the two visible headrests and outward red rear lamps. Side porthole motif omitted at this mild rear camera angle to preserve 96px readability. No promotional poster text or quantity claims copied.
originalMetadata.plateNote: User-requested single Chinese plate glyph, hand-drawn as integer pixels. The central plate is the car's only lettering; the white bumper has no additional badge. The glyph is stamped after pose mirroring.
originalMetadata.rearWhiteStripPlane: rear plane z=0; both strips present in every pose; no white side-plane wrap
